title: Kemacetan Terakhir
threatStyle: Grounded survival outbreak with uncanny, quiet niskala behavior: fixed stares, eerie smiles, and patient rule-testing.

characters.visualDNA: Adult Indonesian woman with short tousled black hair, an olive work jacket over a dark shirt, and a consistent Indonesian right-hand-drive car interior.
Teenage Indonesian girl with uneven dark hair, a fixed stare, and an unsettling closed-mouth smile. Sits quietly in the back seat.
